name: Back Office Bookings
description: A day of bookings with lunch and dinner filters, search, covers against seats, tap-to-call and a status menu: confirmed, arrived, no-show, cancelled.
usage: Give it the /admin/bookings route. Load the day's bookings from your database (or your booking provider's API) and save changes in onStatusChange, onAdd and onDayChange. Security: put every back-office screen behind sign-in (for example Supabase Auth or Clerk), let only the owner's account read or write this data (in Supabase, with row-level security on every table), and keep admin pages out of the public navigation and sitemap.
